narration: Your closest school friend married in Udaipur in month {fork_month}, and you chose {real_choice}. The ghost took {ghost_choice} and was at the wedding. The ghost's money reached its lowest a month later, in month {ghost_lowest_month}. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the two lives were at their furthest apart, and the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month}, the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}. Both lives ended closer to getting by than living, and the ghost's Life came out {life_gap}.
